# Data Model

## AS IS — Current state

### Not applicable in this repository

No persistence layer exists. The digest reports `persistence.present: false` — no migrations directory, no ORM, no models, no database driver in `package.json`, and no DB configuration in `nuxt.config.ts`. All content is static: UI copy, career timeline entries, stat targets, and tech tags live in `locales/en.json` / `locales/pt.json`, and binary assets (CV PDF, favicon, `robots.txt`) live in `public/`. There is no runtime data store or cache the code depends on — interactive state (`countdown`, `isRecording`, typewriter phase, contact form fields) is transient in-memory Vue `ref`/`reactive` state scoped to the client session, discarded on unmount (`app/components/sections/ProjectSection.vue`, `ContactSection.vue`).
